reason: The filing excerpt provided does not contain any company-disclosed Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The document includes operational metrics such as number of ATMs (56,818 as of December 31, 2025), POS terminals (approximately 749,000 for epay segment, 610,000 for EFT segment), transaction volumes, and segment revenue percentages. However, no market size figures (in dollars or other units) are disclosed by Euronet Worldwide itself regarding the TAM for any of its business segments (EFT Processing, epay, or Money Transfer). The filing focuses on company operations, historical growth (e.g., 37.3% CAGR in transactions), and geographic presence across 200+ countries, but does not provide management's assessment of total addressable market opportunity.
